description: This file defines the 'DeviceGrain' class, which is an Orleans grain implementing the IDeviceGrain interface. It manages device state, including retrieving serial number and setting the owner.

classes.name: DeviceGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class managing DeviceState, providing methods to get serial number and assign an owner.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the serial number from the device state.

methods.name: SetOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the device to the specified customer grain and saves the state.
